name: sha256
description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash function. Produces a 256-bit (32-byte) hash value. Conforms to FIPS 180-4.

functions.name: hash
functions.description: Calculate SHA-256 hash of a string.

functions.name: hash_bytes
functions.description: Calculate SHA-256 hash of raw bytes.

functions.name: hash_raw
functions.description: Calculate SHA-256 hash and return as raw 32-byte buffer.

functions.name: verify
functions.description: Verify a string against an expected SHA-256 hash.
